main_body: market stall with awning and counter
top_band: sage green awning (rows 2-12) and brown counter surface around items (rows 25-28)
evidence: The candidate has the exact silhouette and structural layout of the reference cheese stall: an angled awning top surface (rows 2-12) casting a dark shadow (rows 11-14) over the recessed back area, a horizontal counter surface holding items around rows 25-28, and a vertical front panel below (rows 29-40).

style.evidence: The candidate is a quantized, colour-reduced version of the reference stall using only 4 colours total. The awning (rows 2-12) and wooden counter front (rows 29-40) are completely unshaded flat fills of a single colour, lacking the stripes, wood grain, and multi-step shading of the reference.
